page.layout: One column of running text, full page. No marginal notes. Running head "JOH. MORINI." at top with page number 81 at top right. Gathering signature "E 5" at the foot, catchword "trum" at the right below the last line.

main_text.l: se, his verbis Augustino & de illius Doctri-
na detrahere noluisse. Præfatio ista Ar-
Theologis visus fuerat Morinus, dum rem
istam curiosius ac diligentius tractat, Cal-
vinianis favere, qui existimant, in Eccle-
lastici Doctores ac summi Pontifices pri-
scam illam veterum Patrum duritiem e-
strationem in opere suo sibi proposuisse,
sine ipsa remitti. Tertium, satisfactiones peccatis post
Baptismum remittendis esse imponendas. Quartum denique,
pœnas ac antiquis patribus indictas non solùm Ecclesiæ, sed Deo satisfecisse. Ut-

page.notes: Catchword "trum" and signature "E 5" read at the foot. Doubtful: "se," after "præmonet tamen" is printed with a damaged letter; read as "se". Spelling normalised for u/v and i/j per the rules, and long s written as plain s throughout.
